messages:
aj: deployed scope-sanitizer v1.3 to prod ~10m ago. seeing cross-workspace read access to project metadata (teams noticed other orgs' projects in /projects listing). disabling service flagged, opening thread.

maria: wait, that's bad. do you have an example request id?

aj: request_id=req_0a9f... logged in audit — here's raw entry:
```
{ "ts": "2025-04-21T14:11:07Z", "principal":"user:alice@acme.com", "resource":"projects/rdw-42/meta", "org_id":"org-acme", "project_org_id":"org-zenith", "action":"read", "decision":"allow", "policy_version":"scope-sanitizer@1.3" }
```

samir: hmm that project_org_id mismatch suggests policy matcher used project.owner_org not resource.owner_org during refactor. I touched that code in PR #4321.

lucy: @samir can you paste the diff? I can review quick.

samir: gist: https://.../pr4321-diff  (changed: resourceScope = resource.metadata.org || resource.metadata.owner)

maria: security-bot flagged similar anomalies 3h ago — creating incident if not already. @ops-oncall you seeing increased error rates?

ops-oncall: CPU spike on auth-service at deploy time but no real errors. we rolled the deploy back on staging, not prod.

deploy-bot: deploy redwood-infra/scope-sanitizer@v1.3 by samir — rolled out 14:05 UTC — hosts: infra-1..4

aj: mitigation: toggled feature-flag:scope_sanitizer to off at 14:18. That stops leak but we need a patch.

lucy: high-level plan: 1) revert prod deploy or keep flag off 2) patch matcher to use explicit owner_org 3) run audit query to find affected reads 4) rotate KMS keys for any cross-org-encrypted blobs if suspicious 5) run regression tests.

samir: working on fix, pushing hotfix branch now. I will add unit tests asserting owner_org precedence.

aj: running audit query to enumerate exposures:
```
SELECT * FROM access_audit WHERE action='read' AND policy='scope-sanitizer@1.3' AND project_org_id != org_id LIMIT 1000;
```

maria: we should also check KMS acl logs — if any key usage from unexpected tenant principals.

lucy: good call. @security-bot can you dump key usage for past 6h for affected projects?

security-bot: scheduled job started — querying kms:usage logs for keys tagged org in {org-acme, org-zenith} — ETA 30m

aj: for customer comms: shortlist impacted customers (we have small list so far). cc @maria for any legal/reg needs.

maria: acknowledged. start drafting customer notification template: short, apologetic, confirming we revoked access and are rotating keys where needed.

samir: hotfix pushed -> CI green -> deploying to prod now (canary first)

deploy-bot: canary deploy initiated on infra-1 at 14:52

aj: regression tests pass on canary, proceed full rollout

deploy-bot: full rollout complete 14:58

security-bot: KMS usage scan complete — no key usage by foreign principals detected beyond reads matched in audit query. report attached: https://.../kms-scan-1768567890

lucy: ok stopgap OK. action items:
- samir: PR with fix + tests
- aj: run full audit backfill and produce CSV of affected read events
- maria: customer notification & compliance entry
- ops-oncall: monitor for anomalies 72h

maria: also recommend postmortem doc with timeline + root cause (matcher refactor) and next steps (pre-merge policy tests). I'll start doc.

samir: will add integration test to CI that runs policy validation using randomized org/project fixtures.

aj: thanks everyone. follow-up sync tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup:
